_about.readMe: Every key with its default. Copy only the keys you change into ~/.claude/vibequarters.config.json (the installer keeps systemDir and appDir there): a missing key means its default. An object merges key by key; a list replaces the default list. "_about" is documentation and is never read.
_about.systemDir: Where the installer copied the system (hooks, commands, rules, presets). The VibeQuarters app reads this key too.
_about.appDir: The VibeQuarters app's folder. Empty when the app is not installed: hooks that read it then do nothing.
_about.appStateDir: The folder the app keeps its runtime files in. Empty means the app folder.
_about.coordination.liveHours: A session unseen this many hours no longer counts as live.
_about.coordination.lockMinutes: Migration, deploy and merge locks expire after this many minutes.
_about.coordination.gcDays: Sessions unseen this many days are forgotten.
_about.coordination.requestGcDays: Requests and their patch files this old are forgotten.
_about.coordination.forceHandoffMinutes: An unanswered request may be force-handed after this many minutes.
_about.coordination.fixerPrefix: Sessions named <prefix> or <prefix>-<anything> cannot merge: coord.js ship opens a fresh /land tab per PR for them. Empty turns it off.
_about.coordination.landTabOpener: How a fixer's /land tab opens: "vscode" (the code CLI with a vscode://anthropic.claude-code/open URL) or "none".
_about.locks: Commands and MCP tools that take a coordination lock, one row each: lock (its name), shell (regular expression on a shell command) or tool (regular expression on an MCP tool name), deployGate (true also runs the production deploy gate and the stale-deploy check), watchPaths (folders whose uncommitted changes block that deploy). The merge lock is built in.
_about.mergeGate.requiredChecks: "owner/repo": ["check name", ...], the CI checks that prove a repo's tests. A repo not listed falls back to its branch protection.
_about.mergeGate.readBranchProtection: Read the base branch's required status checks with gh when a repo is not listed above.
_about.mergeGate.batchRepos: "owner/repo" entries whose PRs reach the default branch only inside a tested batch (merge-batch.js).
_about.mergeGate.batchIgnoreCheck: "vercel": a batch of several PRs needs main's vercel.json to skip [batch-part] commits (system/templates/vercel-ignore-build.mjs). "none" skips the check.
_about.mergeGate.requirePrDeclaration: When true, merge-batch.js build refuses a PR whose body lacks a "Ships alone: ..." or "Update: <name> part <k> of <n>" line.
_about.mergeGate.requireReview: A merge into a live branch needs a clean fresh review of its exact head (/land). The installer sets false when the merge-gate pack is not chosen; the CI, --admin/--auto and mass-delete checks stay on either way.
_about.loop.autoEvolve: true: a session that leaves lessons behind has the next one run /evolve by itself at a quiet moment. false: it only says so.
_about.mergeGate.reviewerModel: The model the fresh reviewer subagent must have run on, as a regular expression, any case. Empty accepts any.
_about.mergeGate.liveBranches: A PR into one of these branches is going live. Left at main and master, the repo's own default branch on GitHub counts too.
_about.mergeGate.protectedBranches: Deleting one of these branches on the remote is denied. A trailing /* covers everything under it.
_about.mergeGate.ghBudgetMs: Every GitHub read of one guard call shares this many milliseconds.
_about.massDelete.fileLimit: Deleting more files than this is denied; a merge that removes more asks first.
_about.massDelete.projectDirs: Folder names treated as project folders by the mass-delete guard.
_about.hygiene.tokenPatterns: Shapes of secrets that must never be typed into a command (regular expressions).
_about.hygiene.heavyMaxCpu: A heavy job (test suite, build, type check) starts only under this total CPU percent.
_about.hygiene.inlineMaxLines: An inline script longer than this many lines is sent to a file instead.
_about.usage.stepUsd: Say so each time a session passes another multiple of this many API-equivalent dollars.
_about.usage.compactions: And each time it compacts this many more times.
_about.usage.idleMinutes: And when it wakes after this long idle
_about.usage.contextTokens: holding at least this many tokens of context.
_about.loop.defaultProject: A project folder whose learning loop the loop hooks use when the session's own project has none. Empty means none.
_about.skillspector.scanCommand: The command that statically scans a skill, MCP server or plugin folder, shown in the reminder. {dir} is the folder.
_about.edgeDeploy.origin: The Origin header of the edge-function boot probe's CORS preflight.
_about.edgeDeploy.functionsDir: Where a project keeps its edge functions.
_about.edgeDeploy.snapshotDir: Where a pre-deploy snapshot of a live edge function is kept.
_about.notify.count: How many pings, then it stops. 0: five on Windows, where they stay quiet while a terminal or editor has the focus, and one on macOS and Linux, where that cannot be told.
_about.usageLine.warnFrom: Percent of the plan week used before the usage line says when it runs out (mod usage-line).
_about.hqFeed.cacheMinutes: How long the prompt cache lives (mod hq-feed).
_about.hqFeed.pingAtMinutes: An idle chat's cache this old gets a keep-warm ping, only while its switch is on.
_about.hqFeed.tickSeconds: How often the switch and the cache's age are checked.
_about.hqFeed.maxPings: Pings before keep-warm stops by itself.
_about.hqFeed.brakeModel: Subagents on a model matching this regular expression count toward the spend brake.
_about.hqFeed.brakeFree: That many of them a turn starts before the brake asks.
_about.land.cloneRoot: /land looks for a clone of the repo at <cloneRoot>/<repo>.
_about.land.deployCheck: How /land watches a deploy after a merge: "none", "vercel" (a commit status) or "github" (a deployment status).
_about.land.deployContext: The commit status name for deployCheck "vercel".

hqFeed.pingText: Keep-alive ping from VibeQuarters to hold the prompt cache. Reply with the single word: ok
